title: Verify: Contribution handlers, config and routing unit tests
summary: Unit tests proving contribution routes, player history and config defaults work.
description: Unit tests written from the requirement spec with fakes, fixed clock and httptest only. Context: POST/GET contribution routes and player history are served; routes and config are wired. Expected result: all listed tests pass.
acceptance_criteria: Given no valid session cookie, when POST /api/v1/contributions runs, then 401 is returned
Given a valid cookie and valid body {world_id, prompt}, when POST runs, then 201 with the contribution JSON is returned
Given ErrPromptLength/ErrRoundNotOpen/ErrLimitReached/ErrRateLimited/ErrDuplicate, when POST runs, then the status is 400/409/429/429/409 respectively and ErrWorldNotFound gives 404
Given a stored id, when GET /api/v1/contributions/{id} runs, then 200 is returned, and an unknown id gives 404
Given a valid cookie, when GET /api/v1/player/me/contributions runs, then only that player's contributions are returned
Given a YAML config with storage and contribution blocks, when loaded, then fields are parsed and defaults fill omitted limits

preserve: Existing player session handlers in backend/internal/player

technical_constraints: Go 1.22, chi router, no database; persistent data lives in Git as Markdown/YAML
Git writes go through an interface wrapping the Git CLI
definition_of_done: Listed tests pass via the unit command

steps.action: Write test TestCreate_StatusMapping: handler with fake Service dependencies returning each sentinel error; cookie created with player.Sign and fixed Now; assert 401 without cookie, 201 on success, 400/404/409/409/429/429 for errors.
Write test TestGetAndMine: fake Reader; GET known id 200, unknown 404; Mine returns only the cookie player's items.

Write test TestLoadFS_ContributionDefaults: fstest.MapFS config with only auth; assert Storage.RepoPath ".", MaxPerPlayer 5, MaxPromptLen 500; second case with explicit storage and contribution blocks asserts the overrides parse.
Write test TestNew_RegistersRoutes: server.New with a temp RepoPath; GET /api/v1/worlds returns 200 and POST /api/v1/contributions without cookie returns 401.
